goal: Build the new UI shell using the trust foundation from Phase 1. Three lenses (Now, Threads, Recall), one universal list component, sentence-shaped rows, the capture sheet with streaming response, and mobile responsive layouts. Phase 1 must be deployed and stable before Phase 2 launches. The new UI composes existing /api/v4 endpoints (today, summary, search, capture, entities) plus the new /api/v4/threads endpoint. No new AI behavior in this phase — the AI is what Phase 1 made it.
userProblem: The current UI scatters rich signals across 8+ separate views (Home, Today, Inbox, Search, 6 entity lists, Agent Activity, Suggestions). The user has to mentally compose the attention signal, the entity detail, the agent activity, and the capture state to know what to do next. The new design collapses 8 surfaces into 3 lenses + 3 sheets, with consistent sentence-shaped rows and a persistent FAB for capture. The threads concept unifies what was 6 type pages into one ranked list.
whyNow: Phase 1 (skip/uncertain + streaming + narration) rebuilds AI trust at the source. Phase 2 builds the new UI shell that exposes the trust-improved AI behavior. Without Phase 2, the user can't see the streaming capture response in a useful way (it lands on the old capture form which doesn't render events). Without Phase 2, the AI's new skip/uncertain decisions have no UI affordance to display them. Phase 2 is the bridge between Phase 1's backend work and the user's daily workflow.

routesAffected: POST /api/v4/capture (reused; capture sheet uses ?stream=true from Phase 1.2)
dataOrApiDependencies: Slice 2.1 (shell + Now) reuses /api/v4/today, /api/v4/summary with mocked data initially; switches to real data once 2.2 lands

Slice 2.2 (threads endpoint) is the only new backend slice in Phase 2; everything else is frontend. Implementation: extend _coordination_radar_* to return ALL threads (not just top 3) and add /api/v4/threads route handler. Topic clustering via embedding similarity on notes is optional for this phase — can be deferred to Phase 3 if needed

The V4 views (V4Home, V4Today, V4Inbox, etc.) are deleted only after V5 views are verified end-to-end. The deletion is the last step of Phase 2.5, not a separate slice. Until deletion, both V4 and V5 are live and routable via a feature flag in App.jsx

tasks.title: /api/v4/threads endpoint + Threads lens view
tasks.description: Add a new backend route GET /api/v4/threads?rank=attention&limit=20 that returns ranked threads (people + projects + topics). Each thread: id, type, name, attention_score, attention_reasons, last_activity_at, last_context, key_items. Implementation: extend _coordination_radar_people and _coordination_radar_projects to return all threads (not just the radar-culled top 3); add a topic-clustering pass over notes with cosine similarity ≥0.7 to surface topic threads that don't have a parent entity. Add /api/v4/threads route handler. Frontend V5Threads.jsx consumes the endpoint and renders the ranked list (matches v5 mockup m-threads). Topics are a soft pass for this slice — can return [] if clustering is too expensive; ranked people + projects alone is enough to validate the IA.

tasks.title: Capture sheet with streaming response and contextual thread attachment
tasks.description: Build V5CaptureSheet.jsx as a modal sheet (web) or bottom sheet (mobile) that opens from the FAB. The sheet has a single multi-line input. When the user types in a thread context, the sheet auto-attaches to that thread (the attachment is shown at the top, can be changed via a dropdown). On save, the sheet uses POST /api/v4/capture?stream=true and renders live progress events from the SSE stream. After the 'done' event, the sheet closes with a 1.5-second toast 'Saved · AI processing (N applied, M suggested). [View]'. Errors render inline; user can retry. The sheet replaces the old capture form in V4Inbox. The copy in the placeholder text is honest: 'Type anything. I'll suggest what I think it means; you can revert any of it after saving.' NOT 'AI will figure out what you mean' (that was the magical-thinking copy in Pass 2.0, replaced in Pass 2.5).
acceptanceCriteria: ui/src/views/V5CaptureSheet.jsx opens from the FAB on any screen; context-aware: tap from inside a thread → attached by default; tap from Now or Threads → generic
